acceptance_criteria.text: With bookmarks having distinct date_modified values, GET /api/bookmarks/?sort=modified_asc returns the user's bookmarks in ascending date_modified order (oldest-modified first).
GET /api/bookmarks/?sort=modified_desc returns the same bookmarks in descending date_modified order (most recently modified first).
The bookmark list page's sort dropdown contains options labelled 'Modified ↑' and 'Modified ↓', and selecting each one reloads the list ordered by modification date ascending/descending respectively.

The archived bookmarks list page (dropdown and sort query parameter) and GET /api/bookmarks/archived/?sort=modified_asc|modified_desc return archived bookmarks ordered by date_modified ascending/descending.
A request with an unrecognised sort value (e.g. sort=bogus) returns bookmarks in the default order, added date descending (newest first), and does not error.

ambiguities: Ordering of bookmarks with equal date_modified is unspecified (tie-breaker, e.g. by id or added date).

Whether editing a bookmark (title, tags, notes, archive/unarchive, read/unread, metadata refresh) updates date_modified is not stated; tests need to know what counts as a modification to produce a changing order.

The ticket says 'including the archived bookmarks list' but the archived page also has a dropdown; whether it is the same dropdown and whether the dropdown option values are exactly modified_asc/modified_desc is assumed.
Whether the chosen sort persists in the user's profile / bookmark search preferences (as existing sort options do) is not mentioned.
Whether shared bookmarks views (/bookmarks/shared) and the bulk/other list endpoints also need the option is not stated.
Existing sort dropdown labels use 'Added ↑/↓' and 'Title ↑/↓'; option order within the dropdown is unspecified.

Behaviour of an unknown sort value on the page vs. API: the form uses a ChoiceField, so an invalid value may be rejected/ignored differently in the UI than in the API; 'falls back to default' is specified only generally.
Interaction of the new sort with search/tag filters and pagination is not stated.
structured.summary: The ticket adds modified_asc and modified_desc sort values to the bookmark list dropdown and the REST API, including archived bookmarks, with unknown values still falling back to added-descending. All five criteria are testable via API or browser. Main gaps are tie-breaking, what actions update date_modified, and persistence of the choice in user preferences.
